title: Cockney Rhyming Slang in the game we're building..wild.
author: Traditional_Law5082
selftext:
[Carl](https://preview.redd.it/miox9elqi97h1.png?width=1911&format=png&auto=webp&s=a621bb89a2b945bd67df1dd652115d9e4eb1ef0c)

In our game, you're a time traveler, trying to prevent the zombie apocalypse from wiping out humanity. 

To time travel, you have to give just a bit of info on the person you want to leap back to (Sam Bakula style).

  
So meet Carl, who i've told the game 'only speaks in Cockney rhyming slang'

  
  
So in our game (You vs Zombies), in addition to character art, loads of other things get created including dialogue:

https://preview.redd.it/ipcqhp3uh97h1.png?width=729&format=png&auto=webp&s=cb1cc359922a07790c02a2e519632d8026be15e9

and our game's spell system lets the AI manipulate those systems based on the person you want to possess in your time travel leap--in this case, still inspired by cockney rhyming slang per the player's instruction.

https://preview.redd.it/4dddur5zh97h1.png?width=709&format=png&auto=webp&s=31f46826ea7f217be41256cc19c9d3a470cb6ae9

What's wild is how quick and clever the AI systems are where everything happens in 12 seconds....including taking our story bible and the 'cockney rhyming slang' instruction - and it nearly instantly fulfilling that but keeping within the story. And the art, keeping within our artist's art style (our interpretation of Carl, essentially).

I've had equally as much fun making someone who only talks in haikus or who only talks in Dr Seuss rhymes. That's actually my favorite area to mess around, since I was an english major back in the day.

  
\- Susan

comments.author: Proper_Implement_394
comments.body:
Hey! That's crazy!  
Firstly, the idea is so fun and unique. As a fellow English major, I'm impressed! When I leap into a character's mind, I set the way I want him to speak, and the whole language of the game—all the dialogue, maybe even item descriptions—filters through that lens until I leap to a new body, am I correct?  
Secondly, our game is also centered around zombies and time travel haha. What a coincidence!

replies.author: Traditional_Law5082
replies.body:
Yes, that's exactly right - story, dialogue, spells, items, loot (not in yet), boss fight - eveything is hyper personalized in about 15 seconds, all modifying our game systems.
